description: The file defines API routes related to user authentication, including registration, login, and profile retrieval. It uses FastAPI framework components and interacts with authentication services and database sessions.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing user details returned in responses.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing access token response.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for login request payload.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for registration request payload.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user registration; creates a new user via auth_service and returns user info.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user login; validates credentials and returns JWT token.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Retrieves current authenticated user details based on Bearer token.
